armGroups.label: Filgotinib 200 mg
armGroups.description: Filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of methotrexate (MTX)

armGroups.label: Filgotinib 100 mg
armGroups.description: Filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX

armGroups.label: Adalimumab
armGroups.description: Placebo to match filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 100 mg + adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX

armGroups.label: Placebo to Filgotinib 200 mg
armGroups.description: Placebo to match filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX for up to 24 weeks. After 24 weeks, participants will be rerandomized to filgotinib 200 mg to receive filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX.

armGroups.label: Placebo to Filgotinib 100 mg
armGroups.description: Placebo to match filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX for up to 24 weeks. After 24 weeks, participants will be rerandomized to filgotinib 100 mg to receive filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX.

armGroups.label: Placebo Never Received Filgotinib
armGroups.description: Placebo to match filgotinib 200 mg + placebo to match filgotinib 100 mg + placebo to match adalimumab 40 mg in addition to a stable dose of MTX for up to 24 weeks.

interventions.name: Filgotinib
interventions.description: 200 mg or 100 mg tablet(s) administered orally once daily

interventions.name: Adalimumab
interventions.description: 40 mg administered via subcutaneous injection once every two weeks

interventions.name: Placebo to match adalimumab
interventions.description: Administered via subcutaneous injection once every two weeks

participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: Participants were enrolled at study sites in Asia, South Africa, Australia, Europe, North America, South America, and New Zealand. The first participant was screened on 30 August 2016. The last study visit occurred on 20 June 2019.

groups.title: Filgotinib 200 mg
groups.description: Participants were administered a filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily + placebo to match (PTM) filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg subcutaneous (SC) injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 52.1 weeks.

groups.title: Filgotinib 100 mg
groups.description: Participants were administered a filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 52.1 weeks.

groups.title: Adalimumab
groups.description: Participants were administered PTM filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 52.1 weeks.

groups.title: Placebo to Filgotinib 200 mg
groups.description: Participants in the placebo arm were administered a PTM filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily+ a PTM filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 24 weeks. Then the participants in the placebo arm were rerandomized to filgotinib 200 mg and were administered a filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 28.1 weeks.

groups.title: Placebo to Filgotinib 100 mg
groups.description: Participants in the placebo arm were administered a PTM filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily+ a PTM filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 24 weeks. Then the participants in the placebo arm were rerandomized to filgotinib 100 mg and were administered a filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 28.1 weeks.

groups.title: Placebo Never Received Filgotinib
groups.description: Participants in the placebo arm were administered a PTM filgotinib 200 mg tablet orally, once daily+ a PTM filgotinib 100 mg tablet orally, once daily + PTM adalimumab 40 mg SC injection, once every 2 weeks in addition to a weekly stable dose of MTX, orally for median exposure of up to 24 weeks.

achievements.comment: Completed 24 weeks of placebo treatment and not rerandomized to Filgotinib 200 mg or 100 mg groups
